value.rationale: The boundary star is the unique coordinate-star pattern up to cube automorphism and its dimension is minimal among Cartesian hypercube hosts, making the object natural rather than an arbitrary slice. The full exact spectrum and multiplicities reveal a sharp split: one exponentially amplified common-leaf mode, d−1 almost unamplified contrast modes with a rational binomial formula, and a unit center mode. This quantifies the practical distinction between Dirichlet-energy-optimal host completion and Parseval graph analysis while preserving exact reconstruction. The result does not assert optimality among more compact general Cayley hosts or solver ill-conditioning.
